The '''Phosphura Belt Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located within the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the makeshift [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] known as [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|Zirtran's Anchor]]. The [[Phosphura Belt Pirates]] took their name from the nebula.
